data.long_meaning: The name Qusaimah is derived from the Arabic word 'Qasama' which means to follow the Quran. It is a powerful name for a girl, signifying strength and commitment to the teachings of Islam. The name Qusaimah carries the meaning “Life of Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qusaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody life of quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qusaimah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
